about: Documented entrance exceptions for tests/passability.test.js (fixture: harness default seed 12345, hour 12). Each entry must still fail; a fixed entry must be removed. Categories: neighbour-wall-in-front = a later-placed neighbouring wall stands < 3 m in front of the door; neighbour-wall-beside-doorway = the walk to the door stalls on a neighbouring building 8-14 px away; no-street-route = house in an area with no road within 25 m (nearest road sample is on a bridge deck or far away) or beyond the route-search window. Garage gates (kind garage_row) are checked as entries since v79; gate-blocked-by-neighbour = a building cell stands on the gate line.
